title: Self-Pay Rates by Appointment Slot Length for Non-Covered Insured Plan of Care Visits
content:
**Rate schedule — Insured Plan of Care, non-covered visits.** The rate a non-covered visit is charged at follows the length of the appointment slot it was held in, read from the Appointment Series the plan of care funds (the slot length in minutes on the series record):

| Visit | Rate charged |
|---|---|
| A telehealth treatment visit, whatever the slot length | Short-visit self-pay rate, **$88.00** |
| An in-clinic visit in an Appointment Series whose slots last **37 minutes or less** | Short-visit self-pay rate, **$88.00** |
| An in-clinic visit in an Appointment Series whose slots last **53 minutes or more** | Extended-visit self-pay rate, **$156.00** |
| Any other visit (in-clinic, slots of 38 to 52 minutes) | The payer program's self-pay visit rate |

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical slot lengths)

| Slot length of the series | In-clinic visit charged | Telehealth treatment visit charged |
|---|---|---|
| 30 minutes | $88.00 | $88.00 |
| 37 minutes | $88.00 | $88.00 |
| 38 minutes | Payer program's self-pay visit rate | $88.00 |
| 45 minutes | Payer program's self-pay visit rate | $88.00 |
| 52 minutes | Payer program's self-pay visit rate | $88.00 |
| 53 minutes | $156.00 | $88.00 |
| 60 minutes | $156.00 | $88.00 |

**Notes.** A telehealth treatment visit takes the short-visit rate even where its series' slots are long. The 37-minute and 53-minute figures are both inclusive: a slot of exactly 37 minutes is short and a slot of exactly 53 minutes is extended.
